title: Share one guest credential provider per build process; single-flight, cache, jittered backoff; cap static generation workers
description: TI main build on Amplify still fails at static prerender with TooManyRequestsException Rate exceeded despite #206. Cause: runWithAmplifyServerContext({nextServerContext:null}) builds a fresh Cognito credentials provider per call, so each page/read issues its own GetId/GetCredentialsForIdentity, multiplied by Next static-generation workers. Fix: one process-wide provider with single-flight and expiry cache, full-jitter backoff with a 2 minute budget, and capped static generation concurrency in withPapyrus.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Fixed upstream: one shared guest credential provider per process, capped static generation (Papyrus #207, 86e74f45). Recovered from an uncommitted local board during the 2026-10-20 reconcile.
